notes.title: Lynked: Banner of the Spark Launches Today
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x_6zU2ktIhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Lynked: Banner of the Spark is an action-RPG where hack-and-slash combat meets heartfelt community rebuilding. Whether you’re slicing through waves of corrupted Combots or rebuilding a town of friendly Unibots, your every move helps restore a broken world.

Starting today, Lynked 1.0 is officially live and on sale for 20% off starting today through 5/28. After a powerful early access journey, the full version is here, and it’s packed with new missions, new content, and new possibilities based on how you want to play!

[h1]What Is Lynked: Banner of the Spark?[/h1]
At its core, Lynked is a genre-blending game that weaves together the intensity of fast-paced action combat with cozy town building. Think chaotic sword-swinging meets futuristic farmstead, all wrapped in a story of hope, connection, and rebuilding alongside some helpful and handy robots.

Every mission strengthens your bond with the world around you. Playing solo or with friends, the deeper you go, the more you’ll discover this isn’t just a fight to survive. It’s a chance to fortify the resistance and rebuild.

[h1]What Makes Lynked Special?[/h1]
[b]A Genre Mashup We Call Rogue-Life[/b]
Lynked fuses quick, hack-and-slash combat with community sim mechanics, allowing you to battle your way through dangerous biomes while also cultivating a home base for you to customize and level up. Defeating enemies fuels town upgrades, and supporting your town boosts your power in combat. It’s a loop of giving and growing.

[b]Wyre Combat System[/b]
The Wyre is a grapple mechanic that redefines how you move and fight. Use it to grab enemies, launch yourself into battle, or chain devastating combos with speed and style. Combat becomes a fluid, kinetic dance where creativity wins.

It will also support you in town as you come across the sneaky Bittibots or flyfish for Gillibots. Your Wyre is just as important as your weapon when it comes to collecting valuable resources to level up your character.  

[b]Upgrades + Perma Progression[/b]
Every mission brings randomized gear, abilities, and combat modifiers. No two missions are the same, but your long-term progression sticks. From weapon loadouts to Unibot relationships and town development, you’re always building something that lasts.

[b]A Band of Unibots[/b]
Lynked is about togetherness. You can play solo or with friends, but you’ll never be alone. As you explore, you’ll rescue and recruit a quirky cast of Unibots, each one with their own personalities, dialogue, and gameplay perks. From farming and crafting to combat support, these lovable bots are your partners in (re)creation.

[b]Build More Than a Base[/b]
Between battles, unwind with cozy gameplay loops that deepen your bond with the world. Grow crops, cook meals, upgrade facilities, and decorate your hub. Every act of care brings life back to your surroundings and to the characters who call it home.

Lynked isn’t just about restoring buildings. It’s about fighting for a future… and growing one, too.

[h1]What’s New in 1.0?[/h1]
For returning early access players, Version 1.0 brings a host of updates:
[list]
[*] New biomes to explore
[*] Expanded town-building systems
[*] New Unibots and mission types
[*] Performance improvements and polish
[/list]
And most importantly: full console support on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. Check out our patch notes for more detailed information about what’s in the 1.0 patch, and join our [url=https://lynked.gg/dyr]Lynked Community Discord server[/url] to connect with other buddies and strengthen the resistance! 

Jump in today, start building your story, and help ignite the spark for others.

notes.title: Lynked: Banner of the Spark Gears Up for Full Release on May 22, 2025
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! We have some big news that we’re finally ready to share with you.The team is thrilled to announce that Lynked will be coming out of early access for 1.0 launch on May 22, 2025!

[previewyoutube=ozF5rFIR4Ck;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven’t had a chance to try Early Access yet, let us get you up to speed: In Lynked, you are a member of the resistance that will rebuild, battle, and uncover the past in a world reclaimed by rogue machines. With the help of your friendly, neighborhood Unibots, you'll piece together a new home while unraveling their unique quirks, histories, and quests. This adventure isn’t just about survival—it’s about discovery. Every battle fuels your journey, and every structure you build strengthens your next fight.

Read on to learn about early access, our most recent update, and what features you can expect from our official launch.

[h2]A Soulspark for adventure [/h2]
Our official launch on May 22, 2025, introduces five new chapters that expand the story with 40 additional missions, new weapons, five powerful bosses, and the brand-new Voidspyre Biome. You’ll uncover deeper gameplay and strategy with 25 new weapon mods, fresh enemy types, and the special 10-part sidequest: “Banner of the Spark.” 

[h2]A journey through early access, together[/h2]
We’ve been pouring our hearts into this world, and we can’t wait for you to dive into our 1.0 release. Throughout early access, we’ve partnered with our community to build Lynked together. Earlier this year, we released Frostbye– an update that expanded on our weather systems to expand on town life and building while making the environment feel more alive. 

Today, we released the  "Buddy Up!" patch, which brings even more ways to connect with your Unibot allies. Recruit up to 168 Unibots as Battle Companions, and upgrade your home base with a fully equipped kitchen for Chef Brot—where you can cook meals to boost your battle ranks.

[h2]Rebuild together in Lynked on May 22, 2025![/h2]
We’re just getting started, and we can’t wait to take this journey with you. Over the next few months, we’ll be sharing guides, tips, and behind-the-scenes insights from the devs to help you gear up for the resistance.

If you haven’t yet, jump into Early Access and start building your squad! Join us on Steam & Discord to stay in the loop, swap strategies, and be part of shaping the adventure ahead.

💙 See you in town!

[i]Fuzzy Bot Team[/i]

[*] [i]Pepper-Box[/i] (Blaster)
[*] [i]Marty McFries[/i] (Battleboard)
[*] [i]Gronion Glaive[/i] (Basher)

[*] [i]Smeat Kabob[/i] (Spear)

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=B0UDaahMZnM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Let’s welcome our latest Unibot to the neighborhood—Chef Brot![/h3]
Chef Brot is coming to town, and we can’t wait for you to meet him! Once you complete Chapter 1, you’re in for a treat (lol). Say hello to Chef, your newest resident and culinary expert. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/d2c9da404847ae6119018d98a1b12d1419681447.png[/img]
With his own charming personality and plenty of tasks, you’ll quickly learn he’s bringing more than just food; Chef introduces a new cooking system into the game that will enable you to feed the resistance! 

Speaking of… there are a few new recruits who you’ll be able to take alongside you in missions. Let us introduce you to Battle Companions! 


[h3]Team up with Battle Companions to defeat your enemies[/h3]
The Unibots you save in missions across the campaign and through contracts can now join you in battle. You can bring two if you’re playing solo or one with you if you’re adventuring with friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/46b45e721e210870d033a9296c946f36f3700dbd.png[/img] 

We heard your feedback about Lynked’s difficulty — many players expressed that the game was feeling a bit too challenging when playing solo. With these new Battle Companions, you’ll have a helping hand in battle, making the experience more enjoyable and giving you a creative way to take on tougher foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/715a372b01f6419f6de6bc7303bba62ef59a2cee.png[/img] 

Each Companion will have a Spark Power and unique combat skills, which you can improve by feeding them tasty grub—especially their favorite cuisine! As you serve them more and more meals, your companions will rank up, earning stat bonuses, improving their Spark Powers, and even unlocking a special piece of decor!


[h3]We’ve been cooking up something extra special for you[/h3]
Working alongside Chef, you’ll unlock more recipes that show you how to combine your crops together to create delicious dishes. There are 80 ridiculous dishes that mix ingredients like crops with rocks, Gillibots, and even Combot parts to create meals like Grillibot, Mineral Stew, and Smeat Mountain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/377e2bc2541c060253614f1163ee28efbfa29145.png[/img]

We’re not just serving supper— there are also seven new weapons to unlock by cooking the recipes in Chef’s cookbook. New food-themed weapons include: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/936bee4377d53234e1cc4e08edf931f6e52af2df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Gladius Carota Sword 
[*] Smeat Kabob Spear
[*] Pepper-Box Blaster[/list]...to preview a few!

Residents around town seem to have specific food cravings, and you’ll need to complete their flavorful “favors” by giving them their favorite dishes. Completing these favors will unlock rewards along the way and allow you to bond more with your neighbors. 


[h3]Snazzy new cosmetics and player preferences updates![/h3]
We’ve added rumble support for folks who enjoy playing on your Steam Deck or with a controller. This can be disabled through the in-game options menu. 

As another preference update, you can now choose whether weapons from chests match your current weapon’s class. If you prefer, you can switch back to full randomness in the settings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/c7c9dafe93c4eb36bdf0ca3571a0c2c6c6da2d84.png[/img]
Get ready to deck out your space with some seriously snazzy new goodies! There is a new suite of Unibot Resident Statues, and show off your culinary achievements by whipping up delicious meals to earn Chef hats.

Add a dash of flair to your town with charming new decorations like the Chef Action Figure and Poster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/b9c8a85e2dbae1849d4a4f110af826501241f3d6.png[/img]
Explore the new update—Buddy Up!—to discover even more quirky cosmetics and unique decorations. 


[h3]Buddy Up! launches March 25 (It’s going to be delicious)[/h3]
Buddy Up! launches March 25 on Steam—get ready to team up and dive into the fun! Whether you're whipping up a storm in the kitchen or teaming up with your Battle Companions to complete missions, Buddy Up! has something deliciously fun in store. So grab your chef hat, rally your crew, and get ready to cook up some unforgettable adventures! 


Follow our socials to stay in the loop on inside scoop like patch notes, sneak peeks, and exciting updates as we count down to launch! [url=https://lynked.gg/dyr]Join our community Discord[/url] to chat with the devs, connect with other players, and get all the latest on Lynked—we can’t wait to see you there!

notes.title: Developer Deep Dive: The Art and Inspiration Behind Lynked
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction from the Team [/h1]
Hey everyone! I’m Eric—some of you might know me as AD Bot in our [url=discord.gg/playlynked]community Discord[/url] (highly recommend, btw). I’m also the Art Director for Lynked: Banner of the Spark, and I’m excited to take you behind the scenes of how we’re bringing this world to life.

I joined Lynked right at its genesis— there was no artwork, just an incredible spark from our Game Director, Max. Since then, it’s been an amazing journey growing our team and shaping the game’s art direction from scratch. I’ve worked across big and small studios over the years, but this project has been something special: a chance to build a vibrant, dynamic world with a small but mighty team.

Art is at the heart of what makes Lynked feel alive, from the bold colors to the smallest environmental details. So, let’s dive into how we crafted the game’s unique style, the challenges (and breakthroughs) during development, and how our art direction shaped Frostbyte!

[h1]Early Exploration and Art Direction[/h1]
When I first talked to Max, he told me about this project that incorporated a gauntlet with a grappling hook and this kind of robot world. The first thing that triggered in my mind were the colorful, dynamic visuals of games from the late ‘90s and early 2000s. This helped conceptualize many of our characters, but we also wanted to build a lush, bright world that feels organic while still maintaining the mechanical, robotic identity of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/36016b7b90978a0301b73002897d6a63f9ba1c54.png[/img][i]Early character design concept art. [/i]

All these things helped us create this kind of hyper-vibrant vibe, or something I call visual candy. When you look at the screen, it’s so sweet and bold you’re going to get a cavity. This world is meant to be bright, playful, and full of contrast.

The other end of this inspiration produced a kind of vibrant and lively world with high-energy gameplay– something we’ve been calling “Rogue-Life”. Lynked welcomes anyone who loves the creative, relaxing aspects of the game and folks who are here for fast-paced action. That meant designing a world that’s both visually appealing and intuitive—where shapes, colors, and lighting naturally guide you through the game and its levels.

[h1]Development Challenges and Breakthroughs[/h1]
One of the biggest challenges for our team has also been one of our biggest strengths: we’re a small team with developers across multiple timezones. There’s a lot our team wants to achieve, we’ve had to be strategic, flexible, and highly collaborative to bring this world to life.

On the flip side of that, our biggest accomplishments have been a result of our team structure. Small, spread out teams mean that we get a lot of different points of view and a lot of different skill sets. We have two incredible concept artists, Lise and Arthur, who are both in France and they just provide incredible and inspiring art. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/6887a6ee147b3cb1a7ae59cc5d8f21b71d7ffce4.png[/img][i]Early concept art for the loadout zone by Arthur Gorin.[/i]

We also have a tech artist, Don, who is just an absolute MVP on our team. He’s very technical, but he’s also a self-taught artist who created some of the shaders alongside our environment artist, Phil. Their partnership is so inspiring to see, and this cross-discipline collaboration has been essential in maintaining consistency and quality throughout development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/5e54d536dda962a079f03303ce750d88d8aac586.png[/img][i]Final environmental art by Phil Gonzales.[/i]

Some of the best ideas in Lynked have come from moments of creative problem-solving. Whether it’s a technical artist pioneering a new approach to environmental detail or an animator proposing a subtle movement that brings a character to life, every challenge has pushed us to think outside the box.
At the end of the day, the hurdles we’ve faced have only made Lynked stronger. The passion and adaptability of this team shine through in every detail, and we’re excited for you to experience the world we’ve built—one shaped by both careful planning and those unexpected, magical moments of discovery.

[h1]Frostbyte Inspiration and Insights[/h1]
Frostbyte started as a gameplay-driven idea: a way to introduce seasonal changes that would create new activities for you. One of our goals with this update was to give you fresh reasons to explore, experiment, and engage with the world in different ways. Art played a crucial role in reinforcing that experience, making the town and its environments feel transformed by the winter season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/307252b6f73916b1d4f467da8a2d44486cc02c7e.png[/img][i]Wintery town concept art for Frostbyte.[/i]

Our technical artist developed a system to coat the town in snow and adjust environmental effects accordingly. We layered different color variations from soft blues to hints of pink to make sure the world felt cool and cozy, like you’re on your way home through the snow with a warm cup of hot chocolate waiting for you! 

Sometime during development, someone asked, “Okay, if we’re going to do snow, can we do rain?” This gave Max the idea that when it rains or snows, you could also collect different types of Bitibots and Gillibots.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/abb4eb9ff5369653d2f59edf7d78cbe0afcfa5b7.png[/img][i]Concept art for variations of trash Gillibot.[/i]

We leaned into the winter holiday vibes, which led to a Krampus Bitibot or a Candy Cane Gillibot. One of our concept artists presented the idea of a biblically accurate angel Bitibot that was absolutely brilliant. We immediately knew that was going into the game, and the team has absolutely loved that it's become a community favorite.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/5a19bd7530f87d86d9b7a014fc610ba5253d8926.png[/img][i]Concept art for various Frostbyte Bitibots. [/i]

Frostbyte, but really all of Lynked’s development, has been about encouraging everyone on the art team to put their own spin on things, have fun, and feel free to explore– that’s where you get those types of good ideas. 

Another example comes to mind after we had to postpone the Frostbyte update to 2025. Initially, we planned for a December release, but when we decided to push it to January, we saw an opportunity. Instead of just delaying the update, we expanded on it, incorporating elements inspired by Lunar New Year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/b41f87beb8d208f760dbe92fdc1ff3d96f96983c.png[/img][i]Lunar New Year town items concept art.[/i]
 
This gave us the chance to introduce new themed decorations, Gillibots, Bitibots, and items, making the update even more meaningful—especially as we prepared for Lynked’s launch in new regions.

[h1]Building Future Plans with Our Community[/h1]
One of the most rewarding parts of developing Lynked is seeing how you engage with the world we’ve built. Every update is an opportunity to refine, expand, and enhance the game—not just in response to our own ideas, but to what resonates most with our community.

A major focus for us has been balancing the game’s different playstyles. Some folks are drawn to the creative, cozy elements—customizing their town, collecting Bitibots, and exploring the world at their own pace. Others thrive on fast-paced action and combat. Finding that balance is an ongoing process, and every update helps us fine-tune the experience. We want you to feel like there’s something for them, whether they’re here for the adventure, the storytelling, or just the joy of shaping their own space.

Looking ahead, we’re excited to keep developing Lynked in ways that deepen that connection. We’ll be sharing more details on these updates soon, but for now, let’s just say—we’re cooking up something special. 

At the end of the day, Lynked is a game we’re shaping together with all of you. Your feedback, creativity, and excitement fuel everything we do, and we can’t wait to share what’s next. Join us in the community Discord, follow our socials, and let us know what you think. We’ll see you in Lynked!

[h3]- Eric Kozlowsky, Art Director [/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Frostbyte Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/8f1b626af4865f3543a383b27462bbde76b6fa75.png[/img]


[h2]FROSTBYTE IS HERE! [/h2]

The first major content update for Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access has arrived! Check out the patch notes below for all the frosty details: 

 
[h3][b]WHAT'S NEW[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Weather System:[/b] Every four real-time hours, there's a chance of snow or rain in town. 
[list]
[*] [b]New Collectible Critters:[/b] Snowy and rainy days bring out special Gillibots and Bitibots to find! Collect them all to receive blueprints of the new holiday-themed weapons. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Frosteau Arrives in Town:[/b] Meet a mysterious Unibot searching for his missing Cryo Crystals. Help him through limited-time event missions to unlock exclusive rewards. 
[list]
[*] [b]Event-exclusive Rewards:[/b] Collect Cryo Crystals in town or during event missions to trade at Frosteau's Shop for unique weapons, decor, and cosmetics. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Rare Event Tokens:[/b] Dig through snow or leaf piles in town for Red Envelopes that can be exchanged at Frosteau's Shop for a large sum of Cryo Crystals! 

[*] [b]New Weapon Core:[/b] Imbue your weapons with icy attacks to freeze and shatter Combots with the new Freeze Core. 

[*] [b]New Holiday-themed Weapons:[/b] Destroy Combots with new festive weapons, including the Snowing Star (Ringblade,) The Sledder (Battleboard,) Double Dragonhead (Breacher,) and Candy Payne (Basher.) Even more will be added to the lineup in future updates. 

[*] [b]Snowball Fight:[/b] Unibot Residents can now request Favors involving snowball fights. Hit them, and they’ll retaliate—you might even spark a town-wide clash! 

[*] [b]The Snowball Effect:[/b] Intercept runaway Bitibots or catch Gillibots midair by tossing a snowball to momentarily freeze them in place! 

[*] [b]Multiplayer Ping System:[/b] Highlight items like Armor, Health, chests, and weapons during combat to guide your teammates. 

[*] [b]Updated BuddyOS:[/b] Explore the new Armory tab, which showcases Weapons and Weapon Mods. View stats and details of your collected gear in one place. 

[*] [b]Weapons & Mods Filtering:[/b] Prevent specific gear from showing up as loot during mission runs directly from the Armory. 

[*] [b]Expanded Combat Areas:[/b] Day/night variants and new remixes for mission maps essentially double the playable areas within existing biomes. 

[*] [b]Updated Character Customization Screen:[/b] Players can now click on the new “Selfie Mode” option to hide the UI for a better view of the character and outfit. 

[*] [b]New Character Customization Options:[/b] Personalize your character further with eight new eyebrow styles. 

[*] [b]Enhanced Town Management in Multiplayer:[/b] Hosts can now customize town permissions, including max player count and who can build or harvest resources. Choose from three permission levels for players who join your town: 
[list]
    [*] [b]Friends:[/b] Full access to Build Mode and resource harvesting. 
    [*] [b]Guests:[/b] Full access to Build Mode but no resource harvesting. 
    [*] [b]Tourists:[/b] No access to Build Mode or resource harvesting. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Steam Deck Improvements:[/b] This update brings significant enhancements to improve Lynked's compatibility with the Steam Deck, including controller and touchscreen support, reworked default settings, and optimization improvements. While this is an ongoing effort during Early Access, we encourage players to share feedback or contact player support if any major issues arise. 

[*] [b]Changes to Chapters 1 & 2:[/b] We've optimized the flow of the introductory chapters in Lynked. If you encounter any issues with the early missions in the game, please don't hesitate to leave feedback or to contact our player support. 
[/list]
 [hr][/hr]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]  
[*] [b]Spark Powers:[/b] Charges now carry over between rooms (no auto-refill) and recharging stops when rooms are cleared. 

[*] [b]Weapon Specials:[/b] Begin fully charged at the start of new combat rooms.  

[*] [b]Spear Special (Flurry Strike):[/b] Rebalanced damage and reduced the number of hits.  

[*] [b]Battleboard Special (Ten Eighty):[/b] Damage has been increased.  

[*] [b]Electricity (Status Effect):[/b] Reduced the duration of the shocked status effect on players.  

[*] [b]Chest Drops:[/b] Chests are now more likely to provide weapons matching the class of the one currently equipped.  

[*] [b]Player Armor:[/b] Max Armor reduced to three pips, with new "Starting Armor" upgrades in the Sparkhold allowing Max Armor to increase to five pips.  

[*] [b]Town Tools:[/b] Drastically improved responsiveness and speed.  

[*] [b]Town Economy:[/b] Slightly adjusted for better balance.  

[*] [b]Weapon Mods:[/b] Fixed exploits and retuned.  
[/list]
 [hr][/hr]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]  
[*] [b]Improved Framerate (AMD):[/b] Players using AMD GPUs should notice better performance.  

[*] [b]Combo Counter Fix:[/b] The combo counter now correctly registers enemies that self-destruct.  

[*] [b]Cosmetic Items:[/b] Fixed the visuals and icons of certain items for improved consistency.  

[*] [b]Spark Power Descriptions:[/b] Corrected description text for certain Spark Powers.  

[*] [b]Spark Hunter (Weapon Mod) Fix:[/b] Now properly increases the number of Soulsparks dropped by enemies. Happy hunting!  

[*] [b]Decor Categories:[/b] Certain decor items are now sorted into the correct categories.  

[*] [b]Stash Error Message:[/b] Fixed the error message that appears when attempting to stash un-stashable items.  

[*] [b]3D Icon Replacement:[/b] Some Unibots and Residents now use the correct 2D art for their icons.  

[*] [b]Combat Mission Fixes:[/b]  
[list]  
    [*] Resolved issues with enemies spawning in inaccessible areas.  
    [*] Fixed a bug where enemies knocked out of bounds wouldn't get KOed.  
[/list]  
[*] [b]Town Fixes:[/b] Addressed areas where Residents could be thrown into but wouldn’t respawn.  

[*] [b]UI Improvements:[/b] Various UI issues have been fixed.  
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/b20711387751c1150bad4c5744f034ada120cc51.jpg[/img]

 
Hey, everyone! ☃️  

We're incredibly excited to share more details about our major content update, Frostbyte, coming to Lynked Early Access on [b]January 27th[/b]! 


Here's a first look at what's new and what's improved: 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/c68d1960ade2dfc43bdcac4d390dba303efd46b8.png[/img]
[h3=NEW UNIBOT: FROSTEAU]NEW UNIBOT: FROSTEAU[/h3]
Help this eccentric newcomer collect his missing [i]Cryo Crystals[/i] needed to return home! Frosteau introduces limited-time (seasonal) event missions and rewards to Lynked. 


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/d9c44a124b48d8518712ad1f9bd02f9bacb66bdc.png[/img]
[h3]NEW DYNAMIC WEATHER [/h3]
Snow and rain introduce unique [i]Bitibots[/i] hiding in snowdrifts and leaf piles. Plus, catch new [i]Gillibots[/i] exclusive to chilly or rainy weather! 


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/8b12404a8f0279db7fa16c71c9865281e1052666.png[/img]
[h3]NEW EVENT-EXCLUSIVE REWARDS [/h3]
Collect Cryo Crystals in town or complete new event missions, then exchange them at Frosteau's Shop for special [i]Weapons[/i], [i]Decor[/i], and [i]Cosmetics[/i]. Additionally, players can obtain unique Lunar New Year items Frosteau has acquired in his travels! 


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/3906bfb1ad6de97a0de1d28a1ee89d7ef2532db0.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW WEAPON CORE [/h3]
Imbue your weapons with ice attacks to freeze and shatter enemy Combots with the new Freeze Core! 

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/c4b8941b15116d80282ee9dba113bfa349e3433b.png[/img]
[h3]NEW HOLIDAY-THEMED WEAPONS [/h3]
A festive new weapon brand inspired by various holidays is on the way, starting with the Snowing Star (Ringblade), The Sledder (Battleboard), Double Dragonhead (Breacher), and Candy Payne (Basher)! Even more weapons will be added to this lineup in future updates. 

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/198a0f52d9cc6b81d0f6525038aed92b031544c8.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW FAVOR: SNOWBALL FIGHTS [/h3]
With snowy weather comes a new Favor from Unibot Residents. Rile up your robotic neighbors enough, and you might spark a town-wide clash! 

  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/c9d8a74d1e4260cc009a1890a3b31ead9e88629c.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW PING SYSTEM [/h3]
Highlight Chests, Weapons, and Health or Armor pickups to guide friends during co-op missions in multiplayer. 


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/a9cfbbc868e5583023fc8e198c42cc5aee3f4a25.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW ARMORY SECTION [/h3]
Browse all your collected Weapons and Weapon Mods, view their stats, and filter which can appear as loot during missions. 


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/cbe52593c83d07746d32dc8f91e8fe90a8a57062.gif[/img]

[h3]NEW COMBAT AREAS [/h3]
Experience new day/night variants of existing Logwood Pines and Sludgestone Ridge maps, which essentially double the amount of playable areas in Lynked! 

 
[h3]NEW TOWN-MANAGEMENT OPTIONS [/h3]
Hosts can now customize town permissions, including setting a max player count and controlling which visitors can build or harvest resources. 


[h3]NEW LANGUAGE OPTIONS [/h3]
Lynked will now support Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Traditional,) and Chinese (Simplified.) 


[h3]STEAM DECK IMPROVEMENTS [/h3]
This update should enhance the experience for Steam Deck players, with controller and touchscreen support, reworked default settings, and optimization improvements. 

[url=#NEW UNIBOT: FROSTEAU][Back to Top][/url]

 

That’s it for the highlights, but there’s much more to uncover when Frostbyte arrives on [b]January 27[/b].   

In the meantime, and if you haven’t already, now’s the perfect time to join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlynked]Discord[/url]—it's the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and connect with the developers.  

 We'll see you in town!

notes.title: Developer Update #3: Updated Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/34c85d2d7c2f6bf445aa3bf219c55a8585871608.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! Last month, we shared our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3159570/view/6832618064165470447]first roadmap[/url] for Lynked Early Access, outlining plans for the December [i][b]Winter Update[/b][/i] and some additional content originally slated for early next year. As is often the case with game development, this update turned out to be a bit more ambitious than we initially planned! To ensure we can add more features, incorporate community feedback, and deliver a polished experience, the team has decided to move the release date to early 2025. 

To make up for the delay, players who log in between [i]December 19, 2024[/i], and [i]January 6, 2025[/i], will receive a special holiday-themed weapon—the [i][b]Candy Payne[/b][/i] Basher! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/974ac9323db25960acdd27c71fc7b1b896ea7a8a.png[/img]

[*] [b]Weapons & Mods Filtering:[/b] Overwhelmed by all your gear and wish some items could be left out of the rotation during mission runs? No problem! We’re introducing a new system in the [i]Armory[/i] that lets you “ban” specific purchases—a feature highly requested by the community! 
[*] [b]A ton of new combat areas:[/b] We’re introducing day/night variants and new remixes for mission maps, effectively doubling the playable areas within the current biomes! 
[*] [b]New Character Customization options:[/b] We’ve added eight new eyebrow styles to give players even more ways to personalize their characters! 
[*] And, as always, expect more bug fixes, optimization improvements, and more! 
[/list]

Thank you for supporting [i]Lynked: Banner of the Spark[/i] during Early Access! We’re excited to continue building and expanding the game with the community in 2025. If you haven’t yet, join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlynked]Discord server[/url]—it’s the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and connect directly with the developers. 

See you in the game!

notes.title: Lynked Patch Notes 11/19
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/2bbaa3cea031b666016de83612340ad30be32b0c.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! Today, we’re excited to release our first full patch for Lynked: Banner of the Spark! While we’ve rolled out a few hotfixes since launching into Early Access on October 22, this patch is significantly larger (and just the first of many—check out our latest [url=https://lynked.gg/DevUpdate2]Development Update[/url] to learn more.)

Read on to find out what’s new and what’s changed!

[h2]HIGHLIGHTS[/h2]

[b]➤ NEW FEATURE: Offline Mode[/b]
Offline Mode is now available for testing! Please note that if you’d like to sync any progress made in Offline Mode to the cloud, you must first log in. Because of this, we advise against using Offline Mode on multiple devices simultaneously, as this could lead to issues when reconciling save files, potentially causing a loss of progress made during that session. (Offline Mode is still in development, so we're actively working on additional features to improve cloud and local save file management options.)

[b]➤ NOW AVAILABLE: Early Access Freebies[/b]
We intended to release these appreciation rewards at our Early Access launch, so we're happy to announce that they're now available in-game. Thank you for your patience and apologies for the delay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/02f58fe55fbec266ec1a0dcb63f7a0f9662cb561.png[/img]

[h2]WHAT'S NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Expanded Bot-o-Pedia:[/b] Now includes a new session about the Combots!
[*][b]Shared resources in co-op: [/b]Combot materials, Heartdrives, and Soulsparks collected in combat are now shared between all players at the end of a multiplayer mission. 
[*][b]New Sprint options: [/b]A toggle option has been added for the “Sprint” button in the Settings menu, and can be configured separately for each input scheme (controller vs. keyboard). Additionally, holding the “Dodge” button will now only keep Sprint active while it’s held. 
[*][b]Updated character customization screen:[/b] Will now better showcase unique outfit variants.
[*][b]The Smeats have evolved: [/b]These quirky little protein analogs can now talk!
[*][b]Performance and optimization improvements:[/b] We’ve made several updates that should significantly improve how well the game runs on more machines. 
[*][b]Plus, tons of bug fixes:[/b] See below!
[/list]
[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES [/h2]
[h3]COMBAT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sludge (Status Effect): Sludge-affected players experience a 50% reduction in movement speed, and NPC actions are also significantly slowed under its effects. 
[*] Gunner Hound (Cyberus): Increased damage of minigun bullets. 
[*] Hits taken while Overshield (Spark Power) is active no longer reset the player’s K.O. streak. 
[/list]
[h3]MINIBOSSES[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve adjusted the behavior of all Minibosses in Lynked, increasing their aggression, introducing new moves and combos, and rebalancing their health. 
[*] Miniboss Armor is now adjusted based on player count and threat level. For example, Minibosses in 1-Star single player missions have less Armor compared to those in 4-Star multiplayer missions. 
[/list]
[h3]TOWN[/h3]
[list]
[*] The daily seed count in Ivy's Shop has been significantly reduced. 
[*] Fruit sell prices have been increased. 
[*] Tree seeds prices have been increased. 
[*] Tehra's Town Passive "Seed Sale" upgrade now increases seed counts at a much lower rate. 
[*] Increased the pricing for some of Tehra and Ghust's Banner of the Spark Town Passive upgrades.
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the framing on some Unibot icons.
[*] Fixed the Strawberry grow time to match other crops.
[*] Fixed issues with certain decor items being placed against walls.
[*] Fixed the “Splash Bomb” Weapon Mod (Basher) in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an exploit with “Crit of the Spark,” “Core of the Spark,” and similar Weapon Mods that allowed two guaranteed procs instead of one.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to refund Friendchips or Soulsparks, regardless of the number of Heartdrives they had.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to select a “Support-Lynk” in the loadout cart during contracts with the “No Spark Powers” mutator.
[*] Reduced texture memory usage and shader instruction count, improving performance in town and several Logwood Pines combat levels.
[*]Plus several other small fixes and optimization/performance improvements.
[/list]

Thank you once again for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access! If you haven’t already, we encourage you to [url=https://discord.gg/playlynked]join our official Discord server[/url]—it’s the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and hear directly from the developers.

See you in the game!

notes.title: Developer Update #2: 2024 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

My name’s Tatyana Dyshlova, and I’m one of the co-founders of FuzzyBot Games. 

Last month, we released Lynked: Banner of the Spark in Early Access (!!!) and—ever since—our focus has been on building and improving the game alongside our community. So, for our second developer update, we thought it’d be nice to check in on how that’s going, digging into two very specific areas:

[list]
[*] [b]What we’ve learned[/b] (a big THANK YOU to everyone who’s provided feedback so far 🙏)
[*] And, based on that information, [b]what we’re working on next[/b]
[/list]
But first, before we dive into the details, here’s a high-level roadmap for Lynked which covers our planned beats through Early 2025. This is a snapshot of what you can expect from the game and team over the next few months as we work to address your wishes, frustrations, ideas, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/3874206ac7dcc2d5e15dbd52d4e906472b1637ce.png[/img]

To understand what’s informed this roadmap and what else will be included in each beat, keep reading!

[h2]WHAT WE’VE LEARNED[/h2]
Your feedback during Early Access has been absolutely invaluable, and we use a number of different tools and techniques to capture it—things like in-game telemetry, reports submitted to our Player Support Team, posts made on our Steam forums and in our Discord server, commentary from livestreamers and their chats, mentions we see shared across social media, and (last but certainly not least) the reviews you leave right on this platform. 

Over the last four weeks, we’ve been pouring over all this data, looking for popular topics, themes, and trends that will help guide our production priorities and creative resources to make sure we’re evolving Lynked in the ways that matter most to you. Here are our takeaways!

[h3]What’s Working Well[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Visuals and Atmosphere:[/b] Based on your feedback, it seems like we’re generally in a great place vibes-wise. You like the game’s colorful, vibrant art style as well as its collection of playable and non-playable characters alike. 
[*] [b]Co-op Play:[/b] Many of you have called out Lynked’s cooperative multiplayer as an overall positive. More often than not, you think it’s a fun and seamless experience that adds layers of replayability and social enjoyment on top of an otherwise solid core loop. 
[*] [b]Combat System:[/b] On the flip side, we’ve seen a lot of notes that Lynked’s in-game combat system feels pretty good—that it’s smooth and engaging, provides satisfying combos, and offers a variety of weapons and upgrades that allow for diverse play styles.
[*] [b]Variety of Activities: [/b]Beyond combat, you seem to enjoy additional activities like fishing (!!!), catching critter-bots, and town building, all of which add depth and delight. 
[*] [b]Building and Customization:[/b] Speaking of town-building, you also seem to really like the game’s broad options for decorating houses and personal spaces.
[*] [b]Unique Genre Mix:[/b] We’ve seen quite a few comments about Lynked’s combination of hack-and-slash combat vs.cozy town-building, noting that it feels like a good mix of some of your favorite genres and games. (Whoever said that Lynked is “Animal Crossing x Hades,” we love you forever. That is a compliment we not only intend to earn, but also one we’ll take with us to our graves.) 
[/list]
[h3]What Could Be Better[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Minor Bugs:[/b] As an Early Access title, we’ve had our fair share of bugs— including crashes, unresponsive controls, and inventory glitches (some of which have been fixed, and some of which still require attention and resolution). 
[*][b] Performance Issues & Crashes:[/b] We continue to receive reports regarding optimization-related problems, such as frame rate drops and high CPU usage, especially in multiplayer. 
[*] [b]Difficulty Balance: [/b]This is an area without clear consensus, but we do know some of you feel the game is either too easy or too difficult, particularly in missions. The lack of a difficulty system, which could offer more challenge (or accommodate different skill levels) is often mentioned in tandem. 
[*] [b]Gameplay Flow:[/b] We’ve seen comments and posts about delays in loot drops, limited interaction range with items, and slow harvesting mechanics disrupting overall pacing.
[*] [b]Controls and UI:[/b] We’ve also seen comments about Lynked’s counterintuitive controls and inconsistent button mappings, which some players find confusing or cumbersome.
[*] [b]Repetitive Missions:[/b] Some players have expressed that, over time, missions can become repetitive and feel like they lack depth (and that they desire more variety in enemy encounters and mission objectives).
[/list]
[h3]What You’d Love To See
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Difficulty Scaling: [/b]Option(s) to increase mission difficulty with better rewards.
[*] [b]Mission Replay Option:[/b] Ability to replay missions with varied rewards.
[*] [b]Improved Controls and UI: [/b]A more intuitive controller mapping and smoother UI transitions, like using ESC consistently for menu navigation.
[*] [b]Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics:[/b] Auto-loot, replayable missions, and an evasion mechanic.
[*] [b]Enhanced Combat Variety: [/b]More abilities, weapon options, and mission objectives to keep the combat experience fresh.
[*] [b]Enhanced Pet System:[/b] Functional pets with skills like auto-loot and health recovery. Requests to deploy bots as pets or companions to assist in combat or provide utility functions.
[*] [b]Expanded NPC Interactions:[/b] More engaging and dynamic NPC interactions.
[*] [b]Streamlined Harvesting:[/b] Bulk harvesting tools and faster interaction for crops.
[*] [b]Improved Multiplayer Systems:[/b] Shared loot in co-op and a clearer interface for multiplayer. Town permissions to enable safer usage of public towns.
[*] [b]More Customization: [/b]Expanded options for character, house, and pet customization.
[*] [b]Optimized Performance: [/b]Improvements in overall performance, responsiveness, and stability (particularly in multiplayer and across multiple specs). 
[*] [b]Frequent Updates and Fixes: [/b]Continued bug fixes, quality-of-life updates, and new content releases to enhance the game's longevity.
[*] [b]Additional Game Content: [/b]More mission types, environment diversity, and story elements to increase replayability.
[*] [b]Additional Feature & Platform Support:[/b] Steam Deck, Offline Mode, etc.
[/list]
[b][h2]WHAT WE’RE WORKING ON[/h2][/b]
[h3]November 2024[/h3]
This month, we’re looking to drop our first Quality of Life (or “QoL”) patch.

For Lynked, QoL patches will typically be smaller in scope, but the trade-off is that they’re easier and quicker for us to implement. So, while our November patch won’t include any new content, it will include some minor fixes, optimizations, adjustments, and additions that should improve your overall in-game experience. Here are the highlights: 

[list]
[*] Continued bug and crash fixes
[*] Continued performance optimizations 
[*] Shared multiplayer loot
[*] Improved Sprint options
[*] Upgraded Minibosses 
[*] Expanded Bot-o-Pedia
[*] Combat and Town tuning
[*] Offline Mode
[*] And more…
[/list]
[h3]December 2024[/h3]
Next month, we’ll be releasing our first major update! 

This update will be larger in scope than our November patch and will include new content, systems, and features (in addition to continued fixes, optimizations, and tuning). It will also be Winter themed, which means you can expect a feast of festive items to collect. Here’s a first look: 

[list]
[*] Continued bug and crash fixes
[*] Continued performance optimizations 
[*] New Unibot
[*] New Weapon Core
[*] New weather system
[*] Multiplayer ping system
[*] More customization options (including holiday decor and weapons)
[*] Improved new player experience 
[*] And more…
[/list]
[h3]Early 2025[/h3]
As we head into the new year, our exact production calendar becomes a little more nebulous (since we’re still  building out our long-term plans as well as designing / testing out corresponding content). 

That said, you can expect us to continue to release QoL patches and 1-2 major updates in 2025 before our worldwide launch. We look forward to providing more information in the near future, but until then… Here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon:

[list]
[*] Official pet system 
[*] Lunar New Year-themed freebies
[*] Official Steam Deck support
[*] Additional language support
[*] And more…
[/list]
[h3]To Be Determined…[/h3]
Beyond what we’ve listed here, there are a variety of other features, systems, and improvements we want to implement based on player feedback, but that we haven’t slotted into our roadmap just yet. 

While it’s our hope to be able to check each of these off our development checklist as soon as possible, we don’t have any estimated dates to assign to them right now. As a result, we may be able to get to some during Early Access, but others may come after our full release. (We’ll, of course, keep you posted!) Here are a few top items on our backlog: 

[list]
[*] New biomes
[*] Difficulty scaling
[*] Streamlined harvesting 
[*] Replayable missions 
[*] More favor types and status effects
[*] Additional multiplayer systems
[*] And more…
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/1603bdf72f07efb155d18d1239f6bf89d96bd0ea.png[/img]

If you’ve made it this far: We salute you! 

And we hope this update has shed some useful light on what we’ve been working on as a team as well as how your feedback impacts and influences our design decisions. We look forward to sharing even more of these kinds of updates—and another roadmap!—with you early next year. 

[b]Speaking of feedback…[/b]

If you haven’t already, we’d love for you to take our [url=https://lynked.gg/Q42024survey]Q4 2024 Community Survey[/url]! 

As noted earlier, your feedback has helped us make Lynked better than ever, so we wanted to give you a more direct and dedicated space to share your thoughts. Your responses will help us better understand our community and, more importantly, identify the areas of the game that could use our attention. (PS - This survey is open to EVERYONE, too—even if you haven’t played or purchased yet.)


---

Thank you so much for your support, enthusiasm, and candor! Game development can be hard, but we feel so lucky to be creating Lynked: Banner of the Spark for and with each of you. Here’s to many (many) more months of brawling, building, and befriending. 


- Tatyana Dyshlova and the FuzzyBot Development Team

notes.title: Lynked Hotfixes 11/01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/752f1129889473a40bc4d88ccb6f596a72ad2887.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! We hope you're having fun diving into the world of Lynked! This week's patch brings more fixes to the game, alongside gameplay changes to some of our weapons, enemies, and more. Check the full patch notes below:  

[h1]BUG FIXES [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes to various crashes/server timeouts 
[*] Fixed an issue in which Smithy's “Refresh Option” Field Service was not available in multiplayer 
[*] Fixed an issue in which players were unable to pick up Mason's Crafting Station after it was placed 
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Overshield Spark Power did not reflect enemy attacks when upgraded to Level 3 
[*] Fixed an issue in which traps still appeared in the “Dime a Dozen” mission,  despite it having a “No Traps” special rule 
[*] Fixed an issue in which players experienced a network error when returning to town from a mission in multiplayer 
[*] Fixed an issue in which the wrong enemy portrait was displayed in the “KO'd by” section on the end-of-mission screen 
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Module was missing from the Sparkhold to certain players until they left/returned to their town 
[*] Fixed an issue where objects placed on decor items (like tables) that were then stashed would float and become unselectable 
[*] Throwing enemies on Spinner Bots now stuns them 
[*] Spinner Bots can now inflict damage on the Buddy Bait (Spark Power) 
[/list]
[h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES [/h1]
[h3]BLASTER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased damage 
[*] Increased base range 
[*] Reduced hit pause on enemies 
[*] Increased perfect timing window 
[*] Tweaked audio to help players learn the perfect timing rhythm 
[*] Updated Blaster combo—shortened to 3 attacks, and final attack is now a 3-shot burst 
[*] Perfect timing hits (Charge Attack) are now called out on the damage numbers 
[/list]
[h3]BREACHER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Charge Attack can now hit burrowing enemies 
[*] Reduced damage on “Rocket Jump” Special Attack 
[*] Charge Attack damage now scales when the Breacher levels up 
[/list]
[h3]RINGBLADE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased attack speed 
[*] Increased range of the first combo attack 
[*] Decreased downtime between charge → combo attack transition 
[/list]
[h3]BUDDY BAIT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced ability radius 
[*] Reduced initial stun time 
[*] Increased cooldown time 
[/list]
[h3]OVERSHIELD[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased cooldown 
[*] Reduced shield active time to 10 seconds 
[*] Enemy projectiles are now only reflected on Level 3 
[*] Spark Power no longer recharges while shields are active (on caster) 
[/list]
[h3]AIM BOTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a small aim lock pause before they fire 
[*] Increased their aim speed to prevent sprint evasion 
[*] Improved audio timing to broadcast their attacks more clearly 
[/list]
[h3]CHESTS[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Improved Weapon Mod synergies in chests 
[*] [b]Bronze Chests:[/b] weapon drop has guaranteed L1 Core and 1 Weapon Mod 
[*] [b]Silver Chests:[/b] weapon drop has guaranteed L2 Core and 2 Weapon Mods 
[*] [b]Gold Chests:[/b] weapon drop has guaranteed L3 Core and 3 Weapon Mods (when possible) 
[/list]
[h3]OTHER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased cooldown of weapons’ Special Attacks 
[*] Insta-kill hits now only break 1 Armor instead of entire stack 
[*] Reduced stun on Miniboss enemies when their Armor breaks 
[*] Added improvements to the BuddyOS screen's navigation bar 
[*] Banner of the Spark upgrades that affect cooldowns are now less potent 
[*] Enemies now drop loot the moment they're defeated (instead of after they explode) 
[*] Certain potent Banner of the Spark passive abilities had their prices increased 
[*] A Basic Glasses set is now available by default in the character customization menu 
[*] Materials and Soulsparks dropped in combat now have a “glint” effect to improve their visibility 
[*] The Rewards tooltips now appears when players hover over their selections in the Mission Board and Dime's Bounty Board 
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUE:[/b] We have identified an issue where the [i]“Story Log”[/i] menu becomes blank in multiplayer. Starting/returning from a mission, switching to single player, or restarting the game should temporarily resolve this. We’ll implement a permanent fix in the next patch—sorry for the inconvenience! 

[b]➤ About the Early Access Rewards:[/b] While we were aiming on releasing the freebies announced in [url=https://www.playlynked.com/news/early-access-is-now-live]this article[/url] with this week's patch, they'll need a bit more testing before we can add them to the game. We apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience! 

 
Thank you again for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access! If you haven’t already, join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlynked]Discord server[/url]—it’s the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and hear directly from the developers.  

See you in the game!

Thank you for diving into the world of Lynked this week! We've released a small patch to address some issues reported since the October 22 Early Access launch. Check out the full details below:

notes.title: Developer Update #1: Welcome to Lynked!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/7ee06319da252325400fafd61d02d05d711bce45.png[/img]

Hey everyone, 

My name’s Max. And in late 2020, a few of my fellow developers – Tatyana Dyshlova, Jake Warmerdam, Kevin Lin, and Andy Konieczny – and I left the world of AAA development to form our own studio: FuzzyBot Games.

When the five of us started at FuzzyBot, our first collective feeling was “holy ($(%, what the hell did we just do?" Eventually, we moved past our elder millennial existential panic and settled into an energy we still feel to this day, and that was one of profound joy – to be working together as a team and to have a shot creating a game of our very own. This was our opportunity to build a brighter, more uplifting game experience -- one inspired by all the years we spent as kids in front of our Super Nintendo and Sega Genesis consoles, but modernized and made relevant for gamers of today.

Now, four years later, FuzzyBot remains an intentionally small studio. But our first title, Lynked: Banner of the Spark, is a BIG game! With its variety of complex, interlocking systems -- from environmental combat to robot fishing to player customization, online multiplayer, and more – our team of 25 has aspired to punch above our weight since day one…and we will continue to do so throughout Early Access into the 1.0 launch and beyond.

We're nervous, excited, a little delirious, and extremely proud to share this game with you! We can’t wait to listen to your thoughts, ideas, and stories, and to keep working hard to improve and expand on this game with you moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/774f15005a7a01e28b3ce796a511f52525d6a30c.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]WHAT TO EXPECT FROM EARLY ACCESS[/b][/h2]

While we only recently revealed Lynked to the world (a whole two months ago!), it was important to us to get the game into your hands sooner rather than later -- and that's by design. By leveraging Early Access on Steam,  we can get real feedback from real players when it matters most. We can listen to your discussions, learn from your experiences, and start incorporating your feedback into the additions and changes we're planning for launch, which will help us create a better game for everyone.

With this initial release, you can expect many hours of robot-crushing, wyre-ripping, weapon-upgrading, and fish-collecting fun. We've probably missed a few not-so-fun bugs here and there, but our team is quick to respond, so you can expect us to be fixing issues throughout Early Access. (And on that note: We've got some neat quality-of-life improvements already in the works and will be sharing more info with all of you soon!)

In addition to your standard fixes and QoL improvements, we also plan to add new content during Early Access later this year. We’re excited to talk about those plans in the coming weeks, but…between now and then, we’d love to hear from the community about what YOU want to see! Let us know your wildest dreams, your craziest ideas, your most bizarre “what if?”s…and maybe we'll be able to turn them into something cool for launch. (Who knows?! We don't! But we’ll try our best to make it work.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/bb91b6fcba811f9cdc6a85816af0143714372714.jpg[/img]

With all that said, all of us here at FuzzyBot hope you enjoy playing Lynked: Banner of the Spark as much as we’ve had making it. We still have a long road to launch, but the journey is so much better now that you’re a part of it. Thanks so much for joining us (and, more importantly, our robot revolution). 

(PS - If you haven’t already, feel free to stop by our official [url=https://discord.gg/playlynked]Discord[/url]. We’d love to chat with you!)

- Max Spielberg and the FuzzyBot Development Team

notes.content:
If you’ve been considering diving into Lynked: Banner of the Spark, but haven’t made the plunge just yet, then now’s your chance! You still have time to kick off your adventures and start saving our bolts from the Combots by playing the free Steam Next Fest demo, which we’re pleased to share will remain available until [b]10:00 a.m. PT on October 28[/b].

Next Tuesday, October 22, we’re headed straight into Early Access! Today, we’re sharing information on everything you will experience when Early Access begins, a preview of rewards you can earn by watching Lynked streams live on Twitch, and details about what’s included in our upcoming [b]Supporter’s Pack[/b].
[list]
[*] [url=#anchor1]Early Access Content[/url]
[*] [url=#anchor2]Earn Twitch Drops[/url]
[*] [url=#anchor3]Supporter's Pack Details[/url]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/b19bbec7bf10fb076301c8750bbfff3ee391069a.jpg[/img]
[h1]What’s Included in Early Access?[/h1]
If you’ve had the chance to try out our demo and you’re itching for Goodbot to fly you back into the fray, you want to spend more time designing your perfect town, or you just want to round out your Gillibot collection, the Early Access version of Lynked has something for everyone.

[h2 id="anchor1"]More Missions, More Weapons, More. . . Everything![/h2]
Early Access will greatly expand the number of combat-focused story and side missions available to you. It will also bring new Weapon Classes, mid-run Mods, Spark Powers, and Wyre upgrades for you to discover and try out. Along the way, you will rescue and befriend new Unibots, unlock a wide variety of town-building and customization options, and get more in-depth with activities like fishing, farming, and more.

Here’s what we’ve got in store for you when Early Access begins:
[list]
[*] 4 of 9 planned story Chapters, each containing 6 combat missions to conquer as you continue your adventures.
[*] A main cast of Unibot characters to rescue and befriend, including Smithy, Mason, Chip, Nickel, Ivy, Taylor, Dime, and more—each with their own storyline and combat missions to complete.
[*] 2 vibrant and visually distinct biomes to explore: Logwood Pines and Sludgestone Ridge.
[*] Up to 3-player co-op during combat missions, and up to 6-player co-op in town.
[*] 6 new Weapon Classes to discover, craft, and begin mastering, for a total of 10.
[*] A host of mid-run weapon Mods, weapon Cores, Spark Powers, and Wyre upgrades to unlock, equip, and unleash against Combot forces.
[*] Unlock the ability to summon allies to the field and unleash ultimate Support-Lynk attacks that decimate enemies or offer a range of special effects, such as granting Health, Armor, loot, or even new weapons.
[*] The Bounty Board: challenging combat-focused missions that you can revisit again, and again.
[*] Dozens of Unibot residents to rescue, bring home, and befriend.
[*] Additional town-building options and activities to help your budding community flourish.
[*] A broad array of character and town customization and décor items, so that you can show off your own personal style in combat and at home.
[/list]
In addition to everything above, and as part of our launch week celebration, we’re excited to share that [b]players who join us in Early Access from October 22 – 29 will get Lynked for 10% off![/b]

[h2 id="anchor2"]Watch Live on Twitch to Earn Rewards[/h2]
For the first two weeks following our Early Access launch, you can earn a host of cosmetic items to help you customize your look and your home in Lynked by tuning in to your favorite broadcasters on Twitch! All you need to do is ensure you’ve [url=https://jib.fuzzybot.accelbyte.io/]linked your Twitch and Steam accounts[/url], and then watch streamers play Lynked: Banner of the Spark live to start earning your goodies.

[h3]Week 1 Rewards: October 22 - 28[/h3]
During week one, you will earn the [i]Scuba Tank (Backpack)[/i] look, a Map and Anchor skin for Buddy and your Wyre, and a [i]Fish Tank[/i] that you can use to display your latest and greatest Gillibot catch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/1bbac2eec80cd5002082180dfabc8852f5a381c4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/f48978421d014c0c5a86b4edab99c2abde4a7efa.png[/img]

Then, be sure to claim each reward by visiting the Inventory tab in the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]Drops & Rewards page[/url] on Twitch. After that, all that’s left to do is log into the Lynked: Banner of the Spark Early Access client to check out all your new items.

If you would like to add even more flair to your wardrobe and décor collections, you can pick up the Supporter Pack to give yourself a fresh new look! With skins and alternative styling options for your character, a variant for every Weapon Class, new Accessories, and a host of town décor items, this bundle will net you an abundance of options to experiment with as you find your perfect look.

notes.content:
We have been absolutely thrilled to see so many players from our growing community playing Lynked: Banner of the Spark since our free demo went live a little over a week ago. Rescuing [b]Smithy[/b] in the demo will make you eligible to receive the “Buddy’s Mask” headwear and the “Buddy’s Blue Guard” Sword variant. Both items will be added to your account in both the Early Access and Demo version of the game!

[h3]‍Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you’ve completed the requirements mentioned above prior to the start of Steam Next Fest, you’re already eligible to receive your rewards.
[*] These rewards were added to the game after the demo client's latest update on October 11. Players will receive both items in the demo version of the game as well as the Early Access version of the game!
[*] If you're unable to see these rewards, please quit, then restart the game.
[/list]

If you’ve completed the requirements mentioned above by playing the demo by October 21, the rewards will appear in your inventory in the Early Access version of the game [b]after you’ve saved Smithy again[/b]. We have no doubt that this will be a simple feat for an experienced adventurer such as yourself!

We’d greatly appreciate it if you would take a moment to[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159570/] wishlist Lynked on Steam[/url], and we can hardly wait to see you again for the Early Access launch next Tuesday! notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/385b72a7c12abf9e3eb8c580508cab4240bb5803.png[/img]

If you've been waiting for the moment to start bashing up Combots, now’s your chance! We’re thrilled to announce that Lynked: Banner of the Spark will be part of Steam Next Fest! You can even [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159570/]play the demo early[/url], starting TODAY! It will be available until the event ends on October 21. We've put together a rundown of everything you can experience in the demo so you're prepared when you fire it up for the first time.

[previewyoutube=w8OUSh8KRxs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]What to Expect During Steam Next Fest[/h1]
While Steam Next Fest technically begins next week, we wanted to release our demo a little early. This way, you will have some extra hands-on time with the game to complete the first chapter of the story, try different weapon classes, start building out your town, and much more. Here’s what’s included in the demo version of Lynked:
[list]
[*][b]TUTORIAL: [/b]Your adventure begins as you attempt to break out of captivity in a Combot facility. Meet and team up with a friendly bot named Buddy along the way to master the basics of movement and combat, then travel to your town.
[*][b]STORY CHAPTER 1:[/b] Once you’ve completed the tutorial, your town will serve as the staging ground for you to take on all six story missions that make up Chapter 1, as well as several side quests.
[b]THE WYRE AND WEAPON CLASSES:[/b] In addition to wielding the Wyre, which is your versatile grappling hook, you will discover and learn to craft 4 of 10 powerful Weapon Classes: Swords, Bashers, Claws, and Spears.
[*][b]TONS OF UPGRADES:[/b] As you progress through Missions, you will learn to harness new Spark Powers, apply active and passive upgrades for the Wyre, and unlock mid-run mods for different Weapon Classes.
[*][b]TOWN-BUILDING & ALLIES:[/b] Rescue Unibots from the clutches of the Combot army, and then begin forging friendships with them in town. In turn, your new friends will use their unique expertise to teach you how to construct new buildings, upgrade your gear, and more!
[*][b]BOSS FIGHT REWIND:[/b] Once you’ve completed Chapter 1, and shown the Combots that the last of humanity isn’t going down without a fight, you can replay the Cyberus Pack boss fight for additional rewards. Don’t forget to try out different weapons and Spark Powers!
[/list]
Of course, you can dive into the demo solo, but Lynked is even better with friends. Join forces with up to two of your pals to take on missions together in action-packed three-player co-op. Between Missions, join up to five other players in town to build, craft, customize, and fish, among many other activities. If you ever need a hand with a challenging mission, or you’re looking for more teammates, be sure to check out our [url=https://lynked.gg/dyr]Discord server[/url] to lynk up with others in the community.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/3910a35d7c902680ae0a910e3506429529f66744.png[/img]
[h1]Early Access Coming Soon![/h1]
Once Steam Next Fest comes to an end, we’re planning to launch into Early Access on October 22. This version of the game will offer much more story content to explore, additional weapon classes and upgrades to discover, a myriad of town-building options, and much, much more. We will share more details about Early Access in the weeks to come, so check back here for additional information later this month.

Make sure to add Lynked: Banner of the Spark to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159570/]Steam wishlist[/url] to get notified when Early Access begins. We hope you enjoy the demo!
